title: Completion reflector transfers evaluation and coherent internal Hom reindexing
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$, and $B_{W,n}=(\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n)_W$, $R_W=\lim_n B_{W,n}$ for a scheme $W$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Let $g:X\xrightarrow{\sim}Y$ be a scheme isomorphism, with $\ell$ invertible on both schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Put $F=g^{-1}$, with the coefficient identifications induced by all quotient projections. Use the coefficient-stage derived operations of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom].

Write $H_W=R\mathcal Hom_{R_W}$ for ambient completed-ring internal Hom, and let $M,N\in D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ with $H_Y(M,N)\in D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. For any $L\in D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$, precomposition with the canonical ordinary-to-completed tensor unit induces the natural bijections
$$\operatorname{Hom}(M\widehat\otimes^L L,N)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}(M\otimes^L_{R_Y}L,N)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}(L,H_Y(M,N)).$$
Here completed tensor is the quotient-tower completion of ordinary tensor, and the first map is the completion reflector's map for the unit, using the unit-preserving Koszul/quotient comparison [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-completion-reflector]. Completed evaluation is the unique extension of ordinary evaluation along this unit. No perfection of $M$ or completeness of ordinary tensor is assumed.

Under the projection-normalized $F\cong Lg^*$ and tensor comparison of [lem-pod-reindexing-completion-unit-tensor], the ambient $c^0$ of [lem-pod-reindexing-hom-resolution-model] restricts to an isomorphism in the constructible integral category. In particular $H_X(FM,FN)$ is constructible when $H_Y(M,N)$ is. Its completed evaluation equation is exactly the unique extension of the ordinary evaluation equation of [lem-pod-reindexing-evaluation-shift-composition] along the tensor completion unit. Consequently its tensor-Hom transpose is $c^0F(b^\sharp)$ for every completed-tensor map $b:M\widehat\otimes^L L\to N$. Naturality, both signed Hom shifts, and identity and successive scheme-isomorphism comparisons are the ordinary ones transported through these completion units, and commute with both normalized Roos coordinates. The internal-Hom hypothesis specifies the constructible domain only; the ambient comparison needs no such hypothesis.

proof.text: Apply the proved unrestricted normalized reconstruction theorem to the actual coefficient calculus, then use the existing adjunction argument and legacy completeness comparison to obtain the reflector bijection. Use the actual reduction/limit adjunction in the recorded coefficient calculus. Its reductionTensor and the integral tensor model give an isomorphism from completed tensor to the limit of the reduction of ordinary tensor; its inverse after the actual adjunction unit is exactly the displayed tensor unit. Reproduce the normalized reconstruction argument without its unused geometric invertibility parameter: realize a normalized sequence by its canonical DVR tower, apply effectivity and finite counit invertibility, and use conservative finite evaluations to invert the actual counit. For a complete object, compare its quotient tower with the reduction sequence using the K-flat transition formula and transport the Roos triangle. Uniqueness of derived limits and the adjunction triangle then invert the actual unit. The legacy comparison applies this to constructible N. In any adjunction whose counit is invertible on images of the left adjoint, the left triangle makes the image of each unit invertible. Mapping an equality along the left and right adjoints and using unit naturality proves injectivity of precomposition into N; mapping an arbitrary arrow and composing with the inverse unit of N gives its preimage. Transport this bijection through the tensor model isomorphism. This proves precompose_bijective with exactly its published unit, for an arbitrary scheme and without a finite Tor bound.

source.place: Normalized DVR effectivity and reconstruction from the canonical quotient tower; actual adjunction proof as in Sheaf.Paper.PurNormalizedReconstructionAdjunctionCalculus, purNormalizedReconstruction.

proof.text: Use the ordinary closed adjunction recorded in the coefficient calculus and its fixed signed braiding, then compose with step 1. Naturality of the actual reduction unit, reductionTensor and tensor model makes precomposition natural. The counit naturality equations for the closed adjunction give ordinary currying naturality in all three variables; braiding naturality changes to the required M-first order. Applying ordinary currying to the inverse image of the identity under completed currying gives the evaluation extension equation. Injectivity from step 1 gives uniqueness and coherence_iff.

source.place: Step 2: evaluation as adjunction counit; agent completion-reflector refinement.

proof.text: The projection-fixed completed coefficient maps agree by the limit universal property; hence their ordinary derived reindexing functors agree. Transport the ambient comparison through this equality. T.constructible puts FHom(M,N) in the constructible integral category, and the isomorphism-invariance of that category transports it through the ambient Hom comparison to Hom(FM,FN). Fullness restricts exactly the same isomorphism. No assumption on the ordinary tensor and no new preservation lemma is needed.

source.place: Steps 1 and 4: restriction to the constructible-Hom domain.

proof.text: Write $\mu^c:F(M\widehat\otimes^L H_Y)\cong FM\widehat\otimes^L FH_Y$. On ordinary tensors the unit/tensor normalization reads $\mu^c F(\eta_{M,H_Y})=\eta_{FM,FH_Y}\mu^0$. Compare the two maps $F(M\widehat\otimes^L H_Y)\to FN$, namely $e^c_{FM,FN}(1\widehat\otimes c^0)\mu^c$ and $F(e^c_{M,N})$. Precompose with $F(\eta_{M,H_Y})$. Naturality of $\eta$ and step 2 turn the first into $\operatorname{ev}_{FM,FN}(1\otimes c^0)\mu^0$; the second becomes $F(\operatorname{ev}_{M,N})$. They agree by ordinary evaluation compatibility. Under $\mu^0,\mu^c$, this precomposition is the reflector bijection at $X$ with complete target $FN$, so it is injective. This proves the completed evaluation equation.

source.place: Steps 2 and 4: completed evaluation equation by the unit and its universal property.

proof.text: For $b:M\widehat\otimes^L L\to N$, put $b_0=b\eta_{M,L}$. By the definition in step 2, $b^\sharp=b_0^\sharp$. The transported completed map is $\widetilde b=F(b)(\mu^c_{M,L})^{-1}$. The unit equation used in step 4 gives $\widetilde b\eta_{FM,FL}=F(b_0)(\mu^0_{M,L})^{-1}$. Its ordinary transpose is $c^0F(b_0^\sharp)$ by the ordinary evaluation lemma. Applying the composite bijection of steps 1-2 at $X$ shows that the completed transpose is exactly $c^0F(b^\sharp)$.

For naturality, precompose the two candidate completed evaluation maps with the appropriate ordinary-tensor unit. Naturality of the unit reduces them to the ordinary naturality equation, and injectivity from step 1 makes them equal. For either Hom shift, use the signed comparison $H(M[a],N[b])\cong H(M,N)\lbrack b-a\rbrack$: the unit/tensor lemma commutes with those signed shifts, so precomposition reduces the completed square to the ordinary signed square. For identity and successive isomorphisms the same procedure reduces to $c^0_{gh}=c^0_hF_h(c^0_g)$ and the identity equation; the specified tensor compositors and units agree by the unit/tensor lemma. Each resulting equality follows by the same reflector injectivity, so no choice of a new comparison is involved. Finally the unit/tensor lemma realizes these comparisons on the actual strict systems by reindexing both Roos product coordinates, $1-s$ and the cone shift, compatibly with the unit. Thus these very completion-unit extensions commute with both normalized coordinates. The ambient $c^0$ used throughout was constructed without the internal-Hom constructibility hypothesis; that hypothesis was used only in steps 2-3 to stay in the stated full subcategories. For signed_shifts, apply lem-pod-normalized-tensor-signed-shifts for its completed tensor part, use comparison_exists applied to the given c for its ordinary chain and derived Hom shift part, and project both Roos coordinate clauses from hA. The remaining reindexing_laws and identity_composition holes retain their original proof plans.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-NM-a26e88f2f (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item and all six steps in full, against the full statements of all 9 cited nodes and the definitions (D^b_c O_E is a full subcategory and its conditions are invariant under isomorphism; the integral ⊗ is the quotient-tower tensor). I also read the blueprint dual-tate-data-compatibility proof, Steps 2, 4 and 5, and Stacks 099B (algebraization l.1024) and 099M (proetale l.4305). Step 1: the ambient completed-tensor lemma with R=O_E and I=(ϖ) gives B=R_Y; it identifies the unit with the Koszul completion and gives the bijection for constructible complete targets, and the reflector lemma gives the same Hom property for that unit. Step 2: the ordinary adjunction uses the M-left normalization fixed in the evaluation lemma's statement, and e^c is defined as the preimage of id. Step 3: c^0 is an ambient isomorphism; FK≅Lg^*K on complete K by the unit/tensor lemma; Lg^* preserves D^b_c by preserve-constructible clause 1; so H_X(FM,FN) is constructible. Step 4: I recomputed e^c(1⊗̂c^0)μ^c F(η) = ev(1⊗c^0)μ^0 from the unit normalization (the unit/tensor lemma respects the actual reduction/limit unit) and the naturality of η. Injectivity is the reflector map at X with target FN, which is complete by step 3, so these are actual maps and not a finite-level test. Step 5 is a genuine few-line substitution. Step 6 reduces naturality, shifts, compositor, identity and the Roos coordinates to the ordinary lemma and the unit/tensor lemma, using the same injectivity. Edge cases M=0, N=0, Y=∅, g=id and mixed-sign shifts work. No perfection or Tor condition is used, and the Hom-constructibility hypothesis only types the objects. There are no new nodes; the rg -L duplicate search finds nothing that states this, and no SGA is cited. I accept the five tool_uses (ambient-completed-tensor, constant-completion, ringed-reflector, ringed adjunction, preserve-constructible) as generic black boxes outside unit sk-def-weil, with no cycle. proof_deps equals the union of the uses. Advisory: step 1's source lists 099M under algebraization.tex, but 099M is in proetale.tex.
